description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order made to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Red Onions, Dates, etc. be valid for a period of 06 months commencing from 21.11.2016
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory measures specifying tax rates on various commodities, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
